description: This file defines a Java interface 'LoanTransferabilityService' that declares methods related to checking loan transferability and retrieving decline status, likely used across the financial application for loan transfer management.

classes.name: LoanTransferabilityService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for determining if a loan transfer is possible and for obtaining the decline sub-status.

methods.name: isTransferable
methods.description: Checks if the specified loan is transferable given certain external asset owner transfer details.

methods.name: getDeclinedSubStatus
methods.description: Returns the decline sub-status for a loan, indicating reasons why transfer might be declined.
